courses.title: BIOLOGY OF INFECTION AND IMMUNITY
courses.prereqText: Biology 1001A; and either Biology 1002B or Integrated Science 1001X.

courses.title: VIROLOGY
courses.prereqText: Biochemistry 2280A, Biology 2581A/B and Microbiology and Immunology 2500A/B. Pre-or Corequisite(s): It is recommended, but not required, that Biochemistry 3381A be taken previously.

courses.title: BACTERIOLOGY
courses.prereqText: Biochemistry 2280A, Biology 2581A/B and Microbiology and Immunology 2500A/B. Pre-or Corequisite(s): It is recommended, but not required, that Biochemistry 3381A be taken previously.

courses.title: BIOLOGICAL AND SOCIAL DETERMINANTS OF INFECTIOUS DISEASE
MICROBIOLOGY LABORATORY
courses.prereqText: Biochemistry 2280A, Biology 2581A/B, Chemistry 2213A/B and Microbiology and Immunology 2500A/B with marks of at least 60% in each; Pre-or Corequisite(s): Microbiology and Immunology 3400A or the former Microbiology and Immunology 3100A. It is recommended, but not required, that Biochemistry 3381A be taken previously or concurrently.

courses.title: IMMUNOLOGY LABORATORY
courses.prereqText: Microbiology and Immunology 3610F with a mark of at least 60%. Pre-or Corequisite(s): Microbiology and Immunology 3300B.

courses.title: BACTERIAL PATHOGENESIS
courses.prereqText: Microbiology and Immunology 3400A or the former Microbiology and Immunology 3100A, with a mark of at least 70%.

courses.title: MOLECULAR VIROLOGY
courses.prereqText: Microbiology and Immunology 3200B or the former Microbiology and Immunology 3100A, with a mark of at least 70%.

courses.title: INFLAMMATION AND IMMUNOLOGY IN DISEASE
courses.prereqText: Microbiology and Immunology 3300B with a mark of at least 70%.

courses.title: MICROBIAL APPLICATIONS
courses.prereqText: Microbiology and Immunology 3400A or the former Microbiology and Immunology 3100A a mark of at least 70%.

courses.title: BIOINFORMATICS OF INFECTIOUS DISEASE
courses.prereqText: Biology 2581A/B; and either Biology 2244A/B or Statistical Sciences 2244A/B. Pre-or Corequisite(s): One of Medical Bioinformatics 3100A/B, Medical Sciences 3391A/B or Microbiology and Immunology 2500A/B is recommended but not required.

courses.title: RESEARCH PROJECT AND SEMINAR
courses.prereqText: Biochemistry 3381A, Microbiology and Immunology 3200B, Microbiology and Immunology 3300B, Microbiology and Immunology 3400A, Microbiology and Immunology 3610F and Microbiology and Immunology 3620G, with a mark in each of at least 70%. Enrolment is limited and is available only to students in Year 4 of the Honours Specialization in Microbiology and Immunology. Corequisite(s): Microbiology and Immunology 4986Y.
courses.antireqText: Anatomy and Cell Biology 4985E, Biochemistry 4484E, Biochemistry 4985E, Epidemiology and Biostatistics 4900E, Epidemiology and Biostatistics 4985E, Medical Bioinformatics 4985E, Medical Biophysics 4985E, Medical Sciences 4000E, Medical Sciences 4990E, One Health 4985E, Pathology 4985E, Physiology and Pharmacology 4985E, the former Anatomy and Cell Biology 4480E, the former Biochemistry 4483E, the former Chemical Biology 4500E, the former Medical Bioinformatics 4980E, the former Medical Biophysics 4970E, the former Medical Biophysics 4971E, the former Microbiology and Immunology 4970E, the former One Health 4980E, the former Pathology 4980E, the former Physiology and Pharmacology 4980E.

courses.title: BEYOND THE BENCH: BUILDING SKILLS FOR SCIENTIFIC AND PROFESSIONAL SUCCESS
courses.prereqText: Registration in Year 4 of an Honours Specialization in Biochemistry of Infection and Immunity, Microbiology and Immunology, or Microbiology and Immunology with Pathology. Corequisite(s): Microbiology and Immunology 4985E.
